descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group, Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting. We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfill the needs of our local and international partners.
 A typical day might include the following: 
Contributing to the migration and development of a key business application. 
Designing, developing, and maintaining Java-based backend services using Spring Boot. 
Building and consuming REST APIs while ensuring security and performance standards. 
Collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile (SCRUM) environment. 
Participating in code reviews, testing activities, and technical discussions. 
Working with relational databases and supporting CI/CD processes. 
Contributing to software documentation and continuous improvement initiatives.
 To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills: 
3+ years of experience in Java development. 
Good knowledge of Java (11+) and object-oriented programming principles. 
Hands-on experience with Spring Boot; knowledge of Spring Data or Spring Batch is a plus. 
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices-based architectures. 
Familiarity with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito. 
Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL). 
Knowledge of Git, Maven, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins. 
Basic understanding of Docker and Kubernetes. 
Comfortable working in Linux environments. 
Exposure to front-end technologies such as React, JavaScript, or Node.js is considered an advantage. 
Understanding of software design principles and Agile methodologies. 
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 
English and French language skills at B2 level.
 Nice to have: 
Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, JMS).
Knowledge of performance and integration testing tools (Gatling, Karate).
Familiarity with Sonar and testing methodologies such as TDD/BDD.
Exposure to Oracle or NoSQL databases.
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted in a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information provided is treated as confidential.
